name: rescan-only-on-code-change
body: A re-scan is required only when source files actually changed. Whether a re-scan is needed is a function of code-change detection (the scanned revision vs the working tree), never of a metadata mutation. A metadata mutation must not make a re-scan necessary to observe the change. Acceptance: after a metadata mutation the next `apg_query` is already correct with no scan; only a source-file change makes the next scan authoritative.
